children: Onconetix advanced an additional $500,000 to Realbotix, bringing the amount outstanding under their note to $3.0 million.
The additional $500,000 advance was made on October 22, 2026, under the September 11, 2026 grid promissory note.
The note makes loans of up to $5.0 million available to Realbotix.
Including the new advance, $3.0 million is outstanding under the note.
The terms of the note remain unchanged.
